intro: Education and homelab environments were the primary targets in a series of Linux-focused attacks between April 12 and April 30, 2026, with global impact and a notable concentration in South Asia. The activity involved threat actors Harvester, Payouts King, and The Gentlemen, and leveraged CVE-2026-31431, a vulnerability with a CVSS score of 7.8. The seven articles covering this tag included four high-severity incidents, one medium, and two informational reports, affecting the IoT and maker sectors alongside education and homelab systems.
